svg.title: Meeting-room booking chatbot — components and one-turn flow
svg.text: Meeting-room booking chatbot — components and one-turn flow
Every internal node maps to a module in app/; the User and the OpenAI API are external. Numbered arrows trace one chat turn.
Data layer — app/data · all SQL lives here
(db.py schema + seed · repository.py queries) · per-turn connection
bound tools: create · cancel · schedule · my-bookings
username injected server-side — no user / booking_id in schemas
cancel + my-bookings read owned bookings via repo closure (find_by_user)
parse GMT-3 ISO args · delegate to rules + repository
Present but NOT wired into the turn path
implemented + tested — no caller in app/
solid arrow — in-process call / data (double-headed = call ⇄ result)
orange dashed, double-headed, ① ② ③ — LLM calls to
red — stop paths: refusal · error translation · SAFE_FALLBACK
rounded box = module · dashed gray = not in the turn path /
bands = architecture layers; calls point inward:

g.text: ② messages + tool schemas → draft | tool calls (1 + one per tool round)
UNSAFE → fixed refusal (no tools · no verifier)
